You can turn auto-apply on for a segment and choose the mode that fits it.

- You started with the Default segment if you are not using segmentation yet.
- You chose Coverage-first or Cost-first on Overview, in the segment edit dialog, or in the prompt after **Apply all recommendations**.
- You turned auto-apply on for multiple segments from Overview.
- You turned it on for a single segment on Segments.

The same setting is available with the API and with Terraform when you already manage Adaptive Metrics as code. Refer to [Enable auto-apply](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/additional-configuration/auto-apply/).

If you still want the wider Adaptive Metrics flow, take [Optimize your metrics with Adaptive Metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/adaptive-metrics/).
